title.en: The Strokes' early NYC club circuit
title.zh: The Strokes 早期纽约俱乐部回路

venue.en: New York City clubs (Mercury Lounge lore & peers)
venue.zh: 纽约俱乐部（Mercury Lounge 传说与同辈场景）

summary.en: Not one stadium night—club rooms that push Is This It from local buzz to wider radio and fashion.
summary.zh: 不是某一座体育馆——是把 Is This It 从本地传闻推到更广电台与潮流的俱乐部小场。

whyEpic.en: Epic here means hinge, not headcount. Mercury Lounge and related downtown rooms turn Is This It into a city rumor that scales out. Last Nite is the door track; the early rooms reset early-2000s indie cool.
whyEpic.zh: 这里的「史诗」指枢纽，不是人数。Mercury Lounge 及相关市中心小场，让 Is This It 从城市传闻扩出去。Last Nite 是入口曲；早期小场重置了 2000 年代初 indie 的酷感标准。

rightsNote.en: Prefer official audio over bootlegs. No unauthorized full uploads here.
rightsNote.zh: 优先官方音频，而非盗版。此处不上传未授权整场。
